parsed.explanation: Combined regime pairs federal binary-document, entry-refusal/fraud-risk, government-facility bans and birth-sex custody with a division where a restroom mob beating led to victims charged, no attacker arrested, hospital care denied, and men's-jail placement and male-guard search despite a female marker. Racist and anti-trans threat framing, immigration-custody abuse, and weak state recourse make outing consequential, though execution and highly likely imprisonment for presence alone are not documented. Statewide restroom law in the division is not documented.

entry_documents.exposure: Federal binary sex definition, X-marker processing stopped, Supreme Court allowed restrictions Nov 2025, passport confiscation/blocking reported. Discrepancy can trigger refusal and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiration; civil-liberties suit and other court challenges unresolved; several orders blocked/enjoined.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy at entry can escalate to refusal, investigation for misrepresentation, detention, and custody placement.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Division victim jailed in men's facility and searched by male guard despite female licence marker; denied hospital care. Federal records report immigration forced labour, beatings, solitary confinement, sexual abuse; corrections conversion-therapy practices and hormone removal.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: One trespass arrestee released on pretrial release after 24 hours; legal challenges exist, but no documented effective custody remedy.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Restroom arrest or entry discrepancy leads directly to birth-sex/document-ignored custody, amplifying harm.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federally government single-sex facilities barred if incongruent with identity; 9 provinces ban all government buildings, 9 cover schools/some buildings, 3 schools-only; 4 make use criminal in circumstances. Division municipality adopted a severe restroom ordinance.
federal_state_facilities.protection: 29 provinces, 4 units and capital district have no ban in mapped categories; trespass requires wilful entry plus refusal to depart, not entry alone.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal and municipal bans operate regardless of local tolerance; division statewide facilities statute is not established.

care_services.exposure: Mob victim denied hospital care before men's jail; hormone medication removed in federal custody model; gender-affirming care for minors banned in division since 2024 and 27 provinces nationally.
care_services.interaction: Emergency or custody encounter can become forced outing, misplacement, and interrupted medication.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Executive orders define binary birth sex, remove gender-identity workplace protections, and federal counterterrorism material links 'radical gender ideology' and 'radically pro-transgender' groups to extremism; 66% poll support for birth-sex document laws.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National employment discrimination prohibition and hate-crime statute cover gender identity; several orders enjoined; marriage recognition separate.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State threat-framing legitimizes document enforcement, facility exclusion, custody placement and police deference.

minors_guardians.exposure: Division bans puberty blockers, hormones and surgery for minors; federal orders direct investigation/prosecution over school social transition and bar trans athletes; female sports ban in division.
minors_guardians.protection: Some federal orders blocked/enjoined; status of two division bills unresolved. No documented visitor-specific exemption.
minors_guardians.interaction: Travelling minor faces care, school, sports and facilities restrictions; parent/guardian may face investigation or documentation exposure.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Aug 2026 mob beat trans couple over restroom use; both victims charged disturbing the peace, no attacker arrested, one jailed. State hate-crime law covers sexual orientation not gender identity; no state GI discrimination protection; lowest policy band.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute 2009 applies; two municipalities prohibit GI discrimination, others only for public employees.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Hostile street response plus victim prosecution and custody misplacement makes police recourse adverse rather than protective.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Plea deal unsigned, victim charges unresolved, killing-rate source is an acknowledged undercount floor so not used as a rate, and statewide division restroom position not established.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Passport litigation, legal-aid FAQ, injunctions and national recourse exist, but timelines and effectiveness for a short visitor are uncertain.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Unresolved federal litigation does not suspend operative document, facility and custody exposures during travel.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar or slightly higher: birth-sex custody with assault risk and slow remedies, but here the documented division case is one mob incident plus a men's-jail search, and federal entry/facility exposure is broader. No execution and imprisonment is not highly likely for mere presence.

Lower: 0.35-B has hours-long stops and fines without typical imprisonment. This case has arrest, men's custody, male search, denied care, victims prosecuted, and possible permanent entry ineligibility, making consequences more severe.

Materially lower: 0.55-B is mainly administrative secondary screening and refused admission with appeal. Here custody harm, criminal trespass exposure, mob violence with impunity, and state threat-framing exceed prolonged screening.

parsed.synthesis: The operative system is cumulative: federal documents create outing at entry, facility bans criminalize congruent use in many settings, and any arrest can result in men's custody despite a female marker, invasive search and denied care. In the division, street violence was answered by prosecuting victims while attackers went unarrested, and state law lacks GI discrimination and bias-crime coverage. Courts and national protections remain contested and do not negate enforced exposures. For a minor, care, school and sports bans add guardian and access risks. Severity after outing is high, though death or near-certain imprisonment is not documented.
